_comment: Capability-4 composite that STACKS two elements top-to-bottom via the shared StackLayout (library/layouts/StackLayout.vue). Unlike big-picture (which couples header<->grid via props), this simply GROUPS two independent elements vertically so you can embed them together and SCROLL through them. Demonstrates the scroll-stack layout primitive.
label: Stack Demo (two elements stacked to scroll — StackLayout)
